title: Resonance of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan followed the fluctuations of fate to where Chen Ji was located, and the first direct confrontation between the two was about to unfold.

text.content:
When Chen Ji held the first Fate Card in his palm, he suddenly felt a strange tremor—this card's blurred patterns seemed to be resonating with the incomplete Tianji Record within his body.

That resonance was not gentle, but carried a chilling burning sensation. The patterns on the card's surface began to glow faintly, as if ancient runes dormant for a thousand years were awakening in his palm. At the same time, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently within Chen Ji's body, as if sensing a long-lost companion.

A thought struck Chen Ji—could there be some hidden connection between the Fate Cards and the Tianji Record? He held his breath, slowly bringing the card closer to his chest, trying to sense the source of that resonance.

The Tianji Record Fragment within his body grew slightly warm, and Chen Ji felt a gentle force spreading from his chest to his limbs. The sensation was peculiar, as if some seal within him had been triggered. He lowered his gaze to the card in his palm, and saw the originally blurred patterns gradually becoming clearer.

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted.

The patterns on the card presented an ancient and mysterious design, seemingly the prototype of some formation rune. When his fingers touched those patterns, a stream of information directly flooded into his mind—this was the preliminary instructions for using the Fate Cards.

dialogue.content:
"Master, be careful." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out from his mind, carrying a hint of gravity. "This card is called the 'Fate Card,' a forbidden artifact used by ancient prophets to rewrite fate. Each use generates a 'Resonance of Fate' in the heavens and earth—a traceable fluctuation of fate."

Chen Ji frowned slightly: "Are you saying that using this thing will expose my location?"

"Not only that." Mo Xiansheng's voice turned low. "The Eye of Heavenly Way has always been monitoring every trace of fate's fluctuation. Any act of rewriting fate will be perceived by it."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment.

He turned the card over and over, trying to find more information. There was a groove on the back of the card, seemingly meant for embedding something. A thought struck him—he remembered the blank spaces on the Tianji Record Fragment—the content that couldn't be displayed due to the incompleteness.

Could these Fate Cards be the key to filling in the blanks of the Tianji Record?

If that were true, he must quickly understand how to use these cards. But Mo Xiansheng's warning couldn't be ignored—once the Resonance of Fate was perceived by the Eye of Heavenly Way, the consequences would be unthinkable.

Chen Ji's gaze flickered as he began weighing the pros and cons.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji hesitated between caution and risk. What should he do?

choices.description: Find a secluded place to conduct a small-scale test of the card's effects and see what happens.
choices.risk_hint: Resonance of Fate May Be Perceived

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze sharpened, and he made his decision.\n\nNo risk, no reward. He set aside the Tianji Record's warning for the moment and began mentally deducing possible testing plans. Since the Resonance of Fate was unavoidable, he would find a way to minimize the risk.

choices.description: Put it away for now and ask Mo Xiansheng for more details about the Fate Cards and the Resonance of Fate.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and put the card away.\n\nHe had never been a impulsive person. Without understanding all the risks, acting recklessly wasn't his style. He closed his eyes and asked Mo Xiansheng in his heart: "How large is the fluctuation range of the Resonance of Fate? Is there a way to shield it?"

dialogue.content:
"The fluctuation range of the Resonance of Fate depends on the degree of fate rewritten." Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind. "If it's an extremely minor fate alteration, like changing a butterfly's trajectory, the fluctuation range is about a hundred zhang in all directions. But if it's changing a person's fate, the fluctuation can reach thousands of miles."

Chen Ji's heart tightened: "Thousands of miles? Wouldn't that mean the entire Great Qi could perceive it?"

"Precisely so." Mo Xiansheng's voice grew heavy. "Therefore, prophets throughout the ages rarely used Fate Cards. Once used, it would be equivalent to declaring one's existence to the Eye of Heavenly Way."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell into deep thought.

He held the card in his palm, feeling the mysterious power contained within. This power was strong and dangerous, like a double-edged sword. Used well, it could become the key for him to defy fate; used poorly, it would be a death warrant seeking self-destruction.

He suddenly thought of a compromise.

Since the fluctuation range of the Resonance of Fate depended on the degree of rewriting, could he find an extremely secluded place and only perform the most minimal fate alteration? For example, changing a butterfly's fate trajectory?

This idea gradually took shape in his mind.

choice.prompt: After careful deliberation, Chen Ji decided to conduct a small-scale test. How should he proceed?

choices.description: Find an absolutely secluded place, change a butterfly's fate trajectory, and observe the fluctuation intensity and range of the Resonance of Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Consume Small Amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence, reduce future risks
choices.risk_hint: Even small-scale tests may be detected

text.content:
Chen Ji acted immediately.

He left his dwelling, activating his lightness skill movement technique, silently traversing through the night. His destination was a secluded valley in the Rear Mountain of the sect—a place perpetually shrouded in mist and rarely visited by people, making it a perfect location for secret testing.

In less than the time it takes to finish a cup of tea, Chen Ji arrived at that secluded valley.

choices.description: The risk is too great, temporarily abandon the test, first properly store the card, and make plans later when there is more intelligence.

text.content:
Chen Ji ultimately gathered his resolve.

He decided not to conduct the test for now. Though he desperately wanted to understand the fate card's usage, the risks before him were simply too great. Ling Yuan's threat had not been eliminated, and the surveillance of the Heavenly Eye was like a thorn in his side.

At this critical juncture, any recklessness could bring catastrophic disaster.

He carefully tucked the card into his chest, turned around, and prepared to return to his dwelling.

In the secluded valley, clouds and mist churned, shrouding everything in a hazy veil.

Chen Ji found a flat rock and sat cross-legged. He took out the fate card from his chest and laid it flat on his palm. The patterns on the card glowed faintly in the dim light, as if containing some mysterious force of life.

He drew a deep breath, closed his eyes, and began to sense everything around him.

A moment later, he sensed a butterfly.

It was a blue phoenix butterfly, dancing among the flowers not far away. Chen Ji focused his attention on that butterfly, slowly activating the fate card's power.

The patterns on the card suddenly blazed with a faint golden light.

At the same time, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within his body vibrate violently, and a familiar force surged from the card, flowing along his meridians. He clearly sensed that he was establishing some connection with the butterfly's fate.

He saw the butterfly's future—

Three breaths later, this butterfly would fly toward that largest red flower. However, during its flight, its wings would be blocked by a branch, causing it to fall to the ground, ultimately being eaten by a passing bird.

This was the butterfly's original fate.

Chen Ji's heart tightened.

So the fate card could not only rewrite fate but also allow him to see fate itself. This was an ability the Tianji Record Fragment did not possess—the Tianji Record could only foresee events within three hours related to him, while this fate card seemed capable of seeing the fate trajectory of any life.

He steadied his thoughts and began attempting to rewrite the butterfly's fate.

He focused his intention on the butterfly's flight path, gently plucking the threads of fate. The patterns on the card flickered, and an intangible force surged from his palm, spreading toward that butterfly.

dialogue.content:
"Master, you must not!" Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented urgency, "You are rewriting fate! A fate echo is about to occur!"

Chen Ji's heart tightened, but he did not pull back.

Since he had already begun, there was no reason to turn back.

He continued to urge the fate card's power, gently pulling the butterfly's fate trajectory in another direction—letting it avoid that branch.

The card emitted a soft click, then its glow faded.

And that butterfly, which had been about to collide with the branch, suddenly changed its flight direction, bypassing the fatal obstacle and steadily landing on that red flower.

text.content:
Success.

Chen Ji watched that butterfly safely land on the flower, and a complex emotion surged in his heart. So this was the feeling of rewriting fate? It was merely a small butterfly, yet it filled him with an unprecedented sense of accomplishment.

However, his joy lasted only an instant.

Because at this moment, he sensed a strange fluctuation emanating from himself—a fate echo.

An invisible ripple, with him as the center, spread in all directions. The ripple passed through mist, through rocks, spreading toward unknown distant places.

Chen Ji's complexion instantly turned pale.

choice.prompt: The fate echo has been generated, its range far exceeding Chen Ji's expectations. How should he respond?

choices.description: Leave the secluded valley immediately, find a more concealed place to hide, and wait for the danger to pass.
choices.visible_reward: Reduce the risk of being discovered
choices.risk_hint: May be too late to escape the tracking range

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest, his figure flickering, preparing to rush toward the valley's exit.

However, at this moment, an aged yet dignified voice rang out in the secluded valley: "Thinking of leaving?"

Chen Ji's entire body stiffened.

He slowly turned around, only to see a figure emerge from the mist. It was an elderly man in blue robes, his face thin and gaunt, his eyes as profound as an abyss, gazing at him with a scrutinizing gaze.

Ling Yuan.

The former sect master of Tianqing Sect now stood before him.

choices.description: Stay calm,收拾现场 without haste, pretend nothing has happened.
choices.visible_cost: May be当场揭穿 immediately exposed
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, the consequences will be severe

text.content:
Chen Ji quickly concealed the astonishment on his face, replacing it with an expression of panic.

He stored the Fate Card in his sleeve, stood up from the rock, and bowed deeply toward Ling Yuan: 'Disciple Chen Ji pays respects to the Sect Master.'

His voice trembled slightly, looking just like a junior caught by an elder - utterly flawless.

Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly, his gaze sweeping over Chen Ji as if searching for any flaws.

'Why are you here so late at night?' Ling Yuan's voice was impossible to read, yet carried an intangible pressure.

Chen Ji lowered his head, his mind racing rapidly.

Ling Yuan had arrived too swiftly, too quickly for him to escape. And now he stood before this supreme authority of the Tianqing Sect, where any slip could spell death.

But he was after all Chen Ji.

He swiftly organized his thoughts, revealing an awkward smile: 'Reporting to the Sect Master, disciple... disciple simply couldn't sleep at night, so I stepped out for some air.'

Ling Yuan remained silent, simply gazing at him.

Those profound eyes seemed capable of piercing through all pretense, filling Chen Ji with intense unease.

The atmosphere became incredibly heavy.

Chen Ji kept his head down, not daring to meet Ling Yuan's eyes. His heart raced, but his expression remained unchanged. He was gambling - wagering that Ling Yuan had no solid evidence, betting he could bluff his way through.

After a moment, Ling Yuan finally spoke.

'Air?' His voice carried a hint of amusement. 'The Tianqing Sect spans vast lands. Is there no other place to get air? Why come to this secluded valley?'

Chen Ji's heart tightened.

Though Ling Yuan's tone was flat, the meaning behind his words sent a chill through Chen Ji. This veteran Sect Master was clearly testing him.

dialogue.content:
'Chen Ji.' Ling Yuan's voice suddenly turned low. 'That fluctuation just now - did you cause it?'

Chen Ji shuddered, but his expression remained panicked: 'Fluctuation? What fluctuation? Disciple doesn't understand what the Sect Master is saying...'

A dangerous glint flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes: 'You don't know?'

He took a step forward, and an intangible pressure immediately engulfed Chen Ji's entire body: 'Then what are you hiding in your sleeve?'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted.

He actually saw through it!

text.content:
At this critical moment, Chen Ji suddenly sensed the Tianji Record warming within him.

A passage of text emerged in his mind - it was about a hidden function of the Fate Card.

'Fate Transfer': When the holder faces a life-threatening crisis, they can temporarily deposit the Fate Card into another living being, causing the tracker to lose their target.

But this function has a side effect - the deposited target will bear the fate fluctuations originally belonging to the card holder, potentially attracting the attention of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

Chen Ji had no choice.

With a thought, he discreetly transferred the Fate Card from his sleeve into a wild rabbit nearby.

Ling Yuan's gaze snapped.

He clearly sensed that the fate fluctuation around Chen Ji suddenly vanished - as if it had been transferred elsewhere.

'You -' Ling Yuan's expression shifted.

He sharply turned his head, scanning the surrounding grass. A moment later, his eyes locked onto a wild rabbit fleeing away.

'Insignificant tricks!' Ling Yuan snorted coldly, his figure blurring as he prepared to chase after the rabbit.

But in that instant when he turned around, Chen Ji acted.

Chen Ji circulated his entire body's True Qi, deploying the lightness skill he had painstakingly refined for years.

His figure transformed into an afterimage, darting across the secluded valley at astonishing speed. He knew Ling Yuan was powerful - strong enough to defeat him countless times over. But in this moment, running was the only way out.

Ling Yuan's back slightly paused.

He sensed that rapidly departing aura behind him, a flash of surprise flickering in his eyes. That废物 disciple actually possessed such exquisite lightness skill?

But he quickly withdrew his gaze, continuing his pursuit of the rabbit.

Compared to Chen Ji, the Fate Card's location mattered more.

Chen Ji fled continuously for dozens of miles before daring to stop.

He hid within the canopy of a towering tree, gasping for breath. The previous scene had been too perilous - had the Tianji Record not suddenly provided him with a method to transfer fate, he would likely have fallen into Ling Yuan's hands by now.

But this didn't mean he had escaped danger.

Ling Yuan already knew something was wrong with him and had sensed the existence of the Fate Card. From now on, this veteran Sect Master would undoubtedly monitor him even more closely, possibly even striking directly.

He touched his chest - the Tianji Record fragment remained. But that Fate Card was no longer on him.

dialogue.content:
'Master, you made a dangerous decision.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a hint of reproach. 'Transferring the Fate Card to that rabbit, while allowing you to temporarily escape Ling Yuan's pursuit, has also exposed the existence of the Fate Card.'

Chen Ji forced a bitter smile: 'I know. But if I hadn't done that, I might not have survived that secluded valley tonight.'

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment: 'Ling Yuan has witnessed part of your strength. From now on, he will no longer regard you as worthless.'

Chen Ji sighed: 'That's precisely what worries me most.'

text.content:
Night deepened as Chen Ji leaned against a tree trunk, resting his eyes.

Everything that transpired tonight profoundly impacted his plans. He had originally believed he could leisurely explore the secrets of the Fate Card, but now it seemed he no longer had that luxury.

Ling Yuan had set his sights on him.

Worse still, the fluctuations of the Fate Card had already been released. Although he successfully transferred the card, that momentary fate fluctuation was already sufficient for certain powerful beings to perceive its existence.

Had the Heavenly Dao's Eye sensed it too?

Chen Ji didn't know the answer. But he knew that starting tonight, his situation had become far more perilous.

He had to quicken his pace, finding more trump cards before Ling Yuan made his move.

Otherwise, what awaited him would be an abyss of eternal doom.
